HOW TO USE THE BLOCKS / XREFS
EACH SHEET IS A BLOCK NAMED AS LISTED; THE SAME NAME IS ALSO A STAND-ALONE DXF FOR XREF ATTACH.
INSERT OR XREF AT 0,0 SCALE 1, UNITS mm. PLAN GEOMETRY IS 1:1; THE FRAME IS SCALED BY THE SHEET SCALE.
LAYERS: REBAR-BOT / REBAR-TOP / REBAR-U / REBAR-TRIM / CALLOUT / SCHEDULE / NOTES / GRID / OUTLINE / COLUMN / OPENING / VOID / PT-ZONE
EXPLODE THE BLOCK TO EDIT; RE-RUN THE GENERATOR AFTER CHANGES TO THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS.
1. PACKAGE GENERATED FROM THE CONSULTANT'S COMBINED STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS: 2 SLAB LEVEL(S) READ.
3. L01 FIRST FLOOR SLAB PLAN: 19 columns, grid A-B-C-D-E / 1-2-3-4, 2 openings, 2 voids, 1 circular U-bar regions, 1 PT
4. L02 ROOF SLAB PLAN: 20 columns, grid A-B-C-D-E / 1-2-3-4, 2 openings, 1 voids, 2 circular U-bar regions, 1 PT zones,
5. DESIGN DATA READ FROM THE DRAWINGS: topColumns: T16@150 from note "5. TOP BARS OVER COLUMNS: T16@150 B.W. UNLESS
A1. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A2. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@200 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A3. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
A4. Void trimmers not specified: 2T12 T&B each side assumed.
A5. Stock bar length 12 m; laps staggered so that not more than 50 % of bars lap at one section.
